# hello-saas — the smallest company: one standing PM that decides the next
# action on every heartbeat tick, ephemeral crews that scope, implement and
# review under its authority, and a person who answers the merge gate.
apiVersion: poseidon.dev/v1

# --8<-- [start:company]
company:
  name: hello-saas
  vision: >-
    A small SaaS that turns titles into URL slugs, delivered and kept
    green by a company of agents that never exceeds its authority.
  # The people who may act on this company through the console: answer
  # its gates, start or cancel a run by hand, wake, pause or resume the
  # heartbeat, apply this document again, delete the company. On kind,
  # `owner` is the human the chart declares.
  humans:
    - owner
  # The two documents the company writes for itself, in its repository:
  # the strategy (written once from the vision) and the architecture
  # masterplan (written from the vision and the tree, revised on request).
  documents:
    strategy: docs/STRATEGY.md
    architecture: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
  # --8<-- [end:company]

# --8<-- [start:stack]
stack:
  # The one repository this company works on, and the branch its changes
  # are measured and delivered against.
  repo:
    url: github.com/example-org/hello-saas
    base_ref: main
  toolchain:
    image: poseidon-sandbox
    test_command: pytest -q
    egress_allow:
      - pypi.org
      - files.pythonhosted.org
      # --8<-- [end:stack]

# --8<-- [start:standing]
standing:
  pm:
    role: pm
    count: 1
    may_spawn:
      crew: [feature-delivery, feature-review, stewardship]
      max_concurrent: 2
      # --8<-- [end:standing]

# The one place a role's scope is narrowed, for standing and ephemeral
# agents of the role alike; a role not listed keeps its catalog tools.
tools: {}

# The two crewed workflows: which crew fulfils each, the bounds it reads
# and the gates it parks on. Who conducts them, and what the company may
# start on its own, is the heartbeat's to say.
# --8<-- [start:workflows]
workflows:
  implement:
    crew: feature-delivery
    max_verify_retries: 2
  review:
    crew: feature-review
    gates:
      merge:
        resolved_by: human
        # A working day for the person who answers; escalation at half.
        deadline_minutes: 1440
        # --8<-- [end:workflows]

# --8<-- [start:policies]
policies:
  branch_protection:
    protected: [main]
    allowed_pattern: ^feature/[a-z0-9-]+$
  deny_paths:
    - .github/workflows/
    # --8<-- [end:policies]

# --8<-- [start:budgets]
budgets:
  per_run:
    usd: 5
    # How long a run parked at its cap waits for someone to raise it.
    deadline_minutes: 60
    # --8<-- [end:budgets]

# The company's own initiative: who decides, what it may start on its own,
# how many at once, how many tries an item gets, how large the backlog may
# grow before it stops scoping, and the day's cap.
# --8<-- [start:heartbeat]
heartbeat:
  conductor: pm
  reconcile_minutes: 30
  max_concurrent_runs: 1
  max_attempts: 2
  max_open_tickets: 5
  may_start: [scope, implement, review]
  daily_cap:
    usd: 20
    # --8<-- [end:heartbeat]
